items.text: validity jaldi bataye
mera data balance aur validity kya hai Delhi ke liye
Kripya karke sirf mujhe apni current data balance batao
Muzaffarnagar me kaun se plan ke andar mera data bacha hai
Kya aap mujhe mera last recharge ke baad kitna data bacha hai bata sakte ho
Mera account name hai Rajesh Sharma aur mujhe mera data balance janna hai
Main Mumbai se call kar raha hu mera 1GB balance hai ya nahi
Mujhe validity ki date bhi check karwani hai mera connection Gurgaon mein hai

items.context: Kya aapko apna data usage dekhna hai
items.text: Main apne recent usage ke baare mein jaankari chahta hoon

items.context: Aapka registered mobile number kya hai
items.text: Kripya mera balance data aur khaati valid date bataiye

items.context: Verification ke liye ID proof chahiye hota hai kya
items.text: Muhir sir mera ID proof scan karke bhej diya hai kya

items.context: Aapko weekly data usage chahiye ya monthly
items.text: Kya mera last week ka data usage separate mil sakta hai

items.context: Aapke connection ki current validity check karte hain
items.text: Mujhe pata karna hai ki mera data plan expire hone me kitne din bache hain
Maine apne connection ko 15 March ko recharge kara tha uske baad kitna data meri taraf se pending hai
Kya aap mujhe apne latest data usage details de sakte hain kyunki mera data jaldi khatam ho raha hai
Mera naam Sunita Gupta hai, mera mobile number Delhi mein registered hai, kya aap mujhe mera available data bata sakte hain
Main Chandigarh se bol raha hoon mujhe apne data balance ke saath saath iska expiry date bhi bataiye
Mujhe pata karna hai meri mobile line pe kitna data abhi tak bacha hua hai aur kab tak valid hai
Mere account pe last recharge 7 din pehle hua tha abhi mujhe data balance ki jankari dena
Main apna details verify karwana chahta hoon aur mera data balance aur validity check karna hai

items.context: Aap apna registered mobile number bata sakte hain kya
items.text: Ji main aapka registered number confirm karunga, kripya thoda intazaar kijiye

items.context: Kya aap apni location aur number confirm kar denge please
items.text: Aapke Mumbai number ke liye jo last recharge hua tha usmein kitna data balance bacha hai wahi main confirm karta hoon

items.context: Maine aapka data balance check kar liya hai aapko batata hoon
items.text: Aapka 3GB ka plan 28 April tak valid hai aur ab tak 1.2GB data aapke account me bacha hai

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: telecom
Intent: data_balance - asks how much data or validity is left
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: with names, addresses or places; some phrased as questions

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
